historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 5.3% diverges far more than 30% from revenue 3yr CAGR 28.7%. Equity is not a growth signal here: the Nov-2022 IPO inflated FY2022 equity and the company has paid out ~80-90% of earnings since (RMB195m FY2024, RMB215m FY2025, RMB173m declared for FY2025 final). Revenue history (FY2021-25) is also no guide forward: it predates the April-2026 national VBP rollout that turned H1 FY2026 revenue -5.9% YoY.
historical_growth.notes: Only FY2021-FY2025 annuals are available, so 5-year CAGRs are null and 4-year figures are given instead. EPS and FCF 3yr CAGRs are null because FY2022 was negative (net loss -19.8m; owner FCF -47.9m). Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC - interest income; SBC fell from 2.9% to 0% of revenue, so owner FCF has grown faster than reported FCF, the opposite of the usual SBC drag.

scenario_narratives.base: VBP resets metal-occluder prices once; destocking ends in H2 FY2026 and FY2026 revenue is roughly flat (H1 -5.9%, H2 recovering against a VBP-depressed H2 FY2025). From FY2027 biodegradable occluders, ScienCrown TAVR and the 2026-2028 approval wave carry high-single-digit growth that fades to 2.5%; EBITDA margin glides from 57% (FY2025) to 46% on valve mix, elevated selling spend and price governance.
scenario_narratives.bull: VBP volume gains outweigh price cuts, biodegradable occluders become the standard of care outside the procurement basket, TAVR and MCS become a genuine second franchise and overseas CE-marked sales scale. Management's 'relatively high growth' arrives a year late; revenue compounds low-teens through FY2028 with mid-50s margins.
scenario_narratives.bear: Price governance reaches the biodegradable and valve lines, metal occluders keep shrinking, TAVR stays sub-scale against entrenched domestic rivals and approvals slip. Revenue falls in FY2026-27 and EBITDA margin compresses to ~38%, a Lifetech-like level.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A net-cash, high-margin China structural-heart device maker whose legacy occluder franchise has just been pulled into national volume-based procurement. Roughly a third of the market value is financial assets (~RMB1.19bn net of the declared dividend). The valuation question is how far margins fall from the 57-63% of FY2024-25 once VBP and price governance are fully in the numbers, and whether biodegradable occluders and TAVR restore growth. Risk is charged in the flows through a 30% bear weight, not through the discount rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: Expansion of NHSA price governance to biodegradable occluders and aortic valves (the non-VBP growth engine)
Margin compression faster than modelled as selling costs are defended against lower ASPs
Persistent receivables/inventory build under hospital-procurement payment terms depressing cash conversion below the component build
Related-party and conflict risk with controlling shareholder Lepu Medical (entrusted TAVR products, H-share block sales)
FX: CNY/HKD rate is a fixed input; a 5% CNY move shifts HKD value 5%
Cash deployment: a large RMB1.2bn pile could be spent on value-destructive M&A rather than returned

inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1724 HKD per CNY, Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16T22:01Z. Direction: all flows and per-share values are computed in CNY and MULTIPLIED by 1.1724 to reach the HKD quote basis. Triangulation check (no dual listing exists -- the parent 300003.SZ is a different entity): USD/HKD 7.8479 / USD/CNY 6.6768 = 1.1754, a 0.26% tie to the direct cross. refresh_price.py does not move this rate; re-fetch on any later refresh.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z regular close (HKEX, Friday); Yahoo Finance chart API
inputs.wacc_rationale: CNY flows discounted at a CNY-built rate: China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta ~1.0 x China ERP ~7.0% + ~1.2pp size/liquidity premium for a ~HK$4.6bn H-share with a controlling shareholder that has been a seller = ~10.0% cost of equity; no borrowings, so WACC = CoE = 10%. VBP and price-governance risk is charged in the flows (scenario margins/growth and a 30% bear weight), NOT as a WACC premium, and WACC is identical across scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB1.4m (0.59m non-current + 0.81m current portion, 30 Jun 2026) are total_debt; lease principal is not deducted from the flows. Immaterial either way.
inputs.nci_treatment: None -- equity attributable to minority interests is nil (H1 FY2026 balance sheet).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, per .claude/skills/dcf-methods routing (operating company, non-US, dual currency -> owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md). First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY.md entry). OWNER FCF FY0: reported FCF 144.66 (OCF 221.10 - capex incl. capitalised development 76.44) - SBC 15.16 - interest income 18.32 = 111.18. Investment income on wealth-management products (RMB5.2m FY2025) sits in investing cash flow, so it is already outside reported FCF and is not deducted again. FY0 EBITDA (pre-SBC, ex finance and investment income): operating profit 276.54 - net finance income 14.57 - investment income 5.17 + D&A 29.71 + SBC 15.16 = 301.7 = 57.1% of revenue (FY2024 ~63.5%). Seasonality matters: H2 FY2025 EBITDA margin fell to ~39% on VBP disruption and a 50% selling-expense step-up; H1 FY2026 was ~59%. FY2026 base 52% = H1 actual + H2 at ~42% on ~RMB220m revenue. D&A path 9% reflects H1 FY2026 run-rate (intangible amortisation 17.3m + depreciation in COGS/opex ~8.3m = ~25.6m per half) as capitalised development (RMB199m 'development expense' balance) converts to amortising intangibles. WORKING CAPITAL: manufacturer/distributor with receivables (134m) + inventory (96m) far above payables (19m) + contract liabilities (14m); FY2024/FY2025 OCF ran ~RMB38-40m/yr below earnings-plus-D&A, so wc_capture is -50% of the revenue change. BUYBACK: RMB6.46m (HK$7.4m) spent in H1 FY2026 under the 10% mandate approved at the 22 May 2026 AGM; the flat count is otherwise a modelling convention because SBC is now small. Year-1 base owner-FCF margin ~33% vs FY2025 actual 21%: the gap is the FY2025 RMB40m working-capital build and RMB76m capex (14.5%) not repeating at that pace (H1 FY2026 capex was only RMB15.8m), not an unrepeatable one-off being carried. TAX: HNTE 15% rate plus super-deduction for R&D gave 13.3% effective in FY2025 (36.7m on 276.5m) and 13.9% in H1 FY2026; cash path 14% ramping to 15%. EQUITY BRIDGE: cash and bank balances 1,237.3 (30 Jun 2026) + held-for-trading structured deposits 50.0 + certificates of deposit in other non-current assets 67.9 + other equity instrument investment 6.0 - FY2025 final dividend declared and payable at 30 Jun 2026 (RMB0.50/sh, 173.4m; paid after the balance-sheet date, so the stock now trades ex) - lease liabilities 1.4 = net financial assets ~RMB1,186m. The interest income stripped from the flows is the return on exactly these deposits (matching-asset rule).

bear.narrative: The NHSA's price-governance programme extends to biodegradable occluders and aortic valves in a second round, removing the non-VBP shelter that the growth thesis rests on. Metal-occluder revenue keeps falling after the April 2026 tender, TAVR stays sub-scale against Venus, MicroPort CardioFlow and Peijia, and pipeline approvals slip. Revenue declines two years then grows ~3%, and EBITDA margin compresses toward a Lifetech-like high-30s as selling costs are defended against shrinking ASPs.

base.narrative: VBP resets metal-occluder prices once; destocking ends in H2 FY2026 and FY2026 revenue is roughly flat. Growth resumes at high single digits from FY2027 on biodegradable occluder penetration (outside the VBP basket but under price governance), ScienCrown TAVR scaling in 200+ centres and the FY2026-28 approvals (MemoCarna PFO, Bio-Lefort LAA, vascular closure), then fades to 2.5%. EBITDA margin glides from the FY2025 57% to 46% as lower-margin valves grow in mix, selling costs stay elevated and price governance trims ASPs.

bull.narrative: VBP volume gains (hospitals forced onto winning bidders) more than offset price cuts in metal occluders; management's 'relatively high growth' is delayed by one year, not lost. Biodegradable ASD/PFO/LAA occluders take share as the 'implantation without residue' standard of care, ScienCrown TAVR and the MCS pipeline establish a second franchise, and CE-marked overseas sales become a real offset to domestic pricing. Revenue compounds low-teens through FY2028 and margins hold mid-50s.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% default because ~74% of revenue sits under a single regulator (NHSA) that is actively widening procurement and price governance to the products the growth case relies on, and H1 FY2026 already shows the damage. Base held at 50%: the January 2026 tender result is known and management calls the cuts 'within acceptable range'. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things -- biodegradable penetration, TAVR share gains against better-funded rivals, and overseas traction -- to go right together.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
